IV. 1. 122</ls> Belonging to, descended or sprung from, Atri. .{@-यः@} .²1 A descendant of Atri. .²2 The head of the descendants of Atri. .²3 A priest closely related to the Sadasya. .²4 An epithet of Śiva. .²5 An essential humor or juice of the body, lymph. .{@-यी@} .²1 A female descendant of Atri; गोत्रप्रशंसार्थमात्रेष्या अवधसंकीर्तनम् . न चापन्नसत्त्वा आत्रेयी . गोत्रं ह्येतत् . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 1. 9</ls>. .²2 The wife of Atri. .²3 A woman in her courses (रजस्वला); <ls>Ms. 11. 87</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 251</ls>. .²4 Any woman of the Brāhmaṇical order. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a river in the north of Bengal, also called Tista. .²6 A pregnant woman; <ls>Mb. 12. 165. 54</ls>; आत्रेयीमापन्नगर्भामाहुः . अत्र कुक्षौ अस्या विद्यत इत्यात्रेयी . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 1. 7</ls>.
